versions.changelog:
Brand Landing Page Designer v1.0.0

- Introduces a skill for designing polished, brand-first landing and marketing pages for users without established brand identity.
- Guides users through an interactive brand interview to clarify identity, feel, and visual direction before generating any design.
- Leverages Google Stitch SDK to generate, refine, and deliver deployment-ready HTML bundles.
- Clearly defines scope: single-purpose landing pages; excludes dashboards, app UIs, or component-level tasks.
- Provides structured workflow across setup, interview, design system creation, iterative review, and final delivery.
- Includes special handling for user-supplied images: describes and saves them for user reference, but does not use them in generation.
